danny.audio_profile: Danny Ruiz, 38, a night security guard and single dad. Warm, a little gravelly, with a dry sense of humor. He is telling the story of the worst night of his life, quietly, like it still shakes him.

scene: Late at night. Danny sits alone in the dark and tells what happened in the first hour of a zombie outbreak at the shopping mall where he works. Intimate and close to the microphone, no music.
sample_context: A first-person survival story told as a YouTube narration.

chunks.text: [whispers] The dead man pressing his face against my gate used to be my best friend.
[whispers] In about ten seconds, the radio clipped to his chest is going to crackle... and tell every one of them exactly where I'm hiding.
My name is Danny Ruiz. I'm the night security guard at Maplecrest Mall. [dry] And yes, I've heard every mall cop joke there is.
I took the night shift for one reason. [warmly] It means I'm home every afternoon when my daughter Lily gets off the school bus.
[serious, slow] Tonight, he didn't tell a joke.
